parts.text: 无写入探测已确认 CAPTCHA 被接受，真实创建接口到达机构类型校验；未触及数据库。源码显示相同 USCC 的待提交草稿会被复用，所以正式验证将使用带 `T2334` 标记的随机合成编码、唯一名称和合成护照号；测试记录按你的要求保留。验证码及接口返回的账号密码只在进程内使用，不会输出。

tool_input.description: Create one synthetic registration and verify login
tool_input.command: $solverPath = 'C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\skills\captcha-recognizer\scripts\solve-captcha.mjs'; $createAttempted = $false; try { $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssfff'; $tail = '{0:D5}' -f (Get-Random -Minimum 10000 -Maximum 99999); $companyName = 'T2334-' + $stamp; $uscc = '91' + '320594' + 'T2334' + $tail; $legalName = '测试联调'; $passportNo = 'T2334-' + $stamp; $captchaData = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $answerLines = @($captchaData.img | & node $solverPath '-'); $captchaAnswer = ($answerLines -join '').Trim(); if ($captchaAnswer -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$') { throw 'captcha solve failed before create' }; $companyInfo = [ordered]@{ companyType = '01'; uniformSocialCreditCode = $uscc; companyName = $companyName; legalRepresentative = $legalName; legalPersonCertificateType = '004'; corporateIdNo = $passportNo; orgId = 1; outFlag = '1' }; $payloadObject = [ordered]@{ tCyjgInfo = $companyInfo; tCyjgBgxx = [ordered]@{ contacts = $legalName }; code = $captchaAnswer; uuid = $captchaData.uuid }; $payloadText = $payloadObject | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress; $createAttempted = $true; $createResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/company/base/createTempAccount' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $payloadText -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 25; $createResult = $createResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $createCode = [int]$createResult.code; if ($createCode -ne 200 -or -not $createResult.data.userName -or -not $createResult.data.password) { $category = 'other'; if ([string]$createResult.msg -match '统一社会信用代码已存在|企业名称已存在') { $category = 'duplicate' } elseif ([string]$createResult.msg -match '验证码') { $category = 'captcha' } elseif ([string]$createResult.msg -match '企业所属机构不存在') { $category = 'org-mapping' }; 'registrationCode={0}; category={1}; no retry performed' -f $createCode, $category; return }; $tempAccount = $createResult.data; $loginCaptcha = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $loginAnswerLines = @($loginCaptcha.img | & node $solverPath '-'); $loginAnswer = ($loginAnswerLines -join '').Trim(); if ($loginAnswer -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$') { 'registrationCode=200; loginAttempted=false; recordPersisted=true'; return }; $loginPayload = [ordered]@{ username = $tempAccount.userName; password = $tempAccount.password; code = $loginAnswer; uuid = $loginCaptcha.uuid } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress; $loginResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $loginPayload -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 25; $loginResult = $loginResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $loginCode = [int]$loginResult.code; $token = [string]$loginResult.token; if (-not $token -and $loginResult.data -is [string]) { $token = [string]$loginResult.data }; if (-not $token -and $loginResult.data.token) { $token = [string]$loginResult.data.token }; $infoCode = 'not-queried'; $userType = 'not-queried'; if ($loginCode -eq 200 -and $token) { $infoResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/system/user/getInfo' -Method Get -Headers @{ Authorization = ('Bearer ' + $token) } -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15; $infoResult = $infoResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $infoCode = [string]$infoResult.code; if ($infoResult.user.userType) { $userType = [string]$infoResult.user.userType } elseif ($infoResult.data.user.userType) { $userType = [string]$infoResult.data.user.userType } }; 'registrationCode=200; loginCode={0}; getInfoCode={1}; userType={2}; syntheticMarker=T2334; recordPersisted=true' -f $loginCode, $infoCode, $userType } catch { if ($createAttempted) { 'registration attempt outcome may be partial or uncertain; do not retry; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name } else { 'stopped before registration write; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name } }
